created_during: NVIDIA x Red Hat Small Models Hack, Raleigh NC, 2026-10-17/18
method: Seeded sampling of spawns (map.spawnSpots), 2×2 fire seeds from fire-location families (dev/test disjoint), second fire seeds (multi_fire), and electrical failures on interior sliding doors chosen against oracle shortest routes; solvability labels from a full-knowledge grid search at placement time (Daniel on wheelchair-clearance tiles). Fire spread happens later in the engine (seeded, stochastic). No real-world measurements are included.

fire.note: 2×2 seed; spreads stochastically in the engine

electrical.note: disables one interior electric sliding door (its tiles become impassable and opaque)

engine_cross_check: every placement validated with packages/engine validatePlacement
